mera_relevance: Helios is our primary hardware target for MERA circuit execution. The 94 logical qubits enable 40q+ MERA circuits with error protection — sufficient for 5-layer MERA on 32-40 sites. The all-to-all connectivity eliminates SWAP overhead that would plague superconducting alternatives. Commercial availability now confirmed — partnership application is the next step.
